fields.label: Category tag
fields.name: ltt_dive_in_listing_module_eyebrow
fields.instructions: Optional short label above the heading.

fields.label: Content type
fields.name: ltt_dive_in_listing_module_source
fields.instructions: Select a registered public content type to display. The intended Listings type will appear here when it is registered.

fields.label: First dropdown filter
fields.name: ltt_dive_in_listing_module_facet_one
fields.instructions: Choose a FacetWP Dropdown facet whose taxonomy belongs to the selected content type. Create the facet in Settings → FacetWP first.

fields.label: Second dropdown filter
fields.name: ltt_dive_in_listing_module_facet_two
fields.instructions: Choose a different FacetWP Dropdown facet for another taxonomy used by the selected content type.

fields.label: Initial card count
fields.name: ltt_dive_in_listing_module_initial_count
fields.instructions: Number of cards shown before Load More is connected. Three cards fit a desktop row.
